mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate remains persistently below its pre-pandemic median for at least 3 consecutive months, it reduces the real interest rate differential, encouraging equity investors to front-load purchases, thereby driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 30-day rolling mean during the policy regime (t-test p > 0.05), or the pre-pandemic median FEDFUNDS reverts within 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) accompanied by a simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, prompting risk-on equity flows and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by > 5% month-over-month AND UNRATE falls by > 0.2 percentage points in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite meeting the trigger condition in > 60% of similar episodes (backtest robustness), or the correlation between PAYEMS/UNRATE and SPX 20d returns is < 0.3.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average, sustained for two consecutive months, reflects strengthening supply-side demand and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not statistically different from the prior 5-day average during qualifying INDPRO moves (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% for two consecutive months, it triggers a preemptive rate hike expectation, compressing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive despite CPIAUCSL > 3% for 2 months (backtest failure), or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in residential mortgage applications (HOUST) accompanied by a decline in the 10-year Treasury yield (not directly observable, but proxy via FEDFUNDS behavior) signals demand for safe assets, pushing S&P 500 forward returns negative over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by > 10% month-over-month AND FEDFUNDS rises by > 0.2% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during such events, or the HOUST/FEDFUNDS pattern recurs but has no effect on SPX.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% for 4 consecutive months, without a corresponding rise in labor force participation (PAYEMS), suggests a tight labor market that amplifies equity risk appetite and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.0 for 4 consecutive months AND PAYEMS does not increase by > 2% month-over-month
regime_hint: Labor market tightness without participation surge
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not statistically positive during such episodes (p > 0.05), or the effect is explained by other variables (IC > 0.7).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden one-time monthly spike in retail sales (not directly observable, but proxy via PAYEMS or GDPC1) followed by a sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates demand-driven cyclicality, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by > 15% in a single month AND INDPRO falls by > 3% in the following month
regime_hint: Demand shock followed by supply contraction
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during such events, or the shock is not statistically distinguishable from noise (IC < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) crosses above 4% for the first time in a month during a recession (defined as UNRATE > 6.5%), it triggers a supply-side shock that compresses growth expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 4.0 AND UNRATE > 6.5 in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative during such episodes (p > 0.05), or the effect is explained by other variables (IC < 0.3).
